results.content: # Minneapolis ICE shooting live updates: Renee Good's wife speaks out. The Department of Homeland Security has alleged that the victim, Renee Good, was attempting to run over law enforcement officers when an ICE officer fatally shot her Wednesday morning -- a claim that local officials have disputed. Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty reiterated during Friday's press briefing that her office, which covers Minneapolis, has the jurisdiction to make any charging decision in Wednesday's deadly ICE shooting. "We are concerned that the evidence obtained in an investigation that has only been conducted at the federal level will not be shared with our office for review," Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty, whose office covers Minneapolis, said during a press briefing on Friday. Moriarty said the FBI currently has such evidence as shooting victim Renee Good's car, in which Good was shot, and that state investigators do not have access to it.

results.content: The demonstration started peacefully around 7 p.m. local time — “mainly a noise protest,” according to Police Chief Brian O’Hara — outside the Canopy by Hilton Minneapolis Mill District hotel. Minneapolis Mayor Jacob Frey and Police Chief Brian O’Hara are providing an update on the overnight anti-ICE protests and the city’s plans for upcoming demonstrations this weekend. At least 30 people were detained and later released after Minneapolis police declared an unlawful assembly as hundreds of protesters converged on a downtown hotel late last night, officials said. Tensions erupted in downtown Minneapolis overnight Friday into Saturday, as hundreds of protesters packed the streets over the killing of Renee Good, a mother of three who was fatally shot this week by an ICE agent involved with President Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown. Police in Minneapolis declared an unlawful assembly and formed lines to clear the streets shortly after protesters converged on a hotel, under what seemed to be the belief that federal officers were staying there, CNN’s Omar Jimenez reported from the scene.
